opcoesSql: SELECT DISTINCT C007_Id AS valor, COALESCE(NULLIF(C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem nome') AS titulo
INNER JOIN C019 ON C019_C007_Id = C007_Id

sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,

CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0), T007_D024_Id, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT('cad:', COALESCE((SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0), T007_D024_Id, 0)) ELSE CONCAT('T007:', T007_Id) END AS clienteId,

COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Cliente proposta ', (SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0)) ELSE NULLIF(T007_Cliente_Razao, '') END, 'Sem cliente') AS cliente, COALESCE(T007_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno, 0) AS responsavelId, COALESCE(NULLIF(C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem vendedor') AS responsavel,

LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = COALESCE((SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0), T007_D024_Id, 0)
LEFT JOIN C007 ON C007_Id = T007_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno
AND T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe) <> ''

AND NOT ((T007_C004_Id = 1 AND COALESCE(T007_D024_Id, 0) IN (22460, 19367, 21746, 46617)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C004 empresaTransferencia WHERE empresaTransferencia.C004_Id = T007_C004_Id AND TRIM(empresaTransferencia.C004_Cnpj) IN ('17750961000540', '17.750.961/0005-40')) AND COALESCE(T007_D024_Id, 0) IN (20516, 19367, 21746)))

AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Cliente proposta ', (SELECT MIN(proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T007A proposta WHERE proposta.T007A_T007_Id = T007.T007_Id AND proposta.T007A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0)) ELSE NULLIF(T007_Cliente_Razao, '') END, 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = COALESCE((SELECT MIN(proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T003A proposta WHERE proposta.T003A_T003_Id = T003.T003_Id AND proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0), T003_D024_Id, 0)
LEFT JOIN C007 ON C007_Id = T003_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno

AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T003A proposta WHERE proposta.T003A_T003_Id = T003.T003_Id AND proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Cliente proposta ', (SELECT MIN(proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta) FROM T003A proposta WHERE proposta.T003A_T003_Id = T003.T003_Id AND proposta.T003A_D024_Id_Cliente_Proposta > 0)) ELSE NULLIF(T003_Nome_Cliente, '') END, 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

carteiraRepresentantes: SELECT CONCAT('cad:', c.D024_Id) AS clienteId, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem cliente') AS cliente,
c.D024_C007_Vendedor_Interno AS vendedorId, COALESCE(NULLIF(v.C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(v.C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem vendedor') AS vendedor,
r.D021_Id AS representanteId, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.D021_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem nome') AS representante
INNER JOIN D021 r ON r.D021_Id = c.D024_D021_Id AND r.D021_Id > 0
LEFT JOIN C007 v ON v.C007_Id = c.D024_C007_Vendedor_Interno
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))
carteiraRegioes: SELECT CONCAT('cad:', c.D024_Id) AS clienteId, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem cliente') AS cliente,
c.D024_C007_Vendedor_Interno AS vendedorId, COALESCE(NULLIF(v.C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(v.C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem vendedor') AS vendedor,
COALESCE(u.D018_UF, '') AS uf, COALESCE(ci.D020_Id, 0) AS cidadeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.D020_Nome_Cidade, ''), 'Cidade não informada') AS cidade,
COALESCE(r.D084_Id, 0) AS regiaoId, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.D084_Regiao, ''), 'Sem região cadastrada') AS regiao, COALESCE(ci.D020_Codigo_IBGE, '') AS cidadeIbge
LEFT JOIN C007 v ON v.C007_Id = c.D024_C007_Vendedor_Interno
LEFT JOIN D018 u ON u.D018_Id = c.D024_D018_Id
LEFT JOIN D020 ci ON ci.D020_Id = c.D024_D020_Id
LEFT JOIN D084 r ON r.D084_Id = ci.D020_D084_Id
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))
metasVendedores: SELECT m.SMT120_C007_Id AS vendedorId, m.SMT120_Data_Inicial AS inicio, m.SMT120_Data_Final AS fim,
m.SMT120_Valor_Meta AS meta, m.SMT120_Valor_Atingido AS atingido, m.SMT120_Percentual_Atingido AS percentual
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C019 vinculo WHERE vinculo.C019_C007_Id = m.SMT120_C007_Id AND vinculo.C019_C004_Id = :empresa)
territoriosRegioes: SELECT u.D018_UF AS uf, ci.D020_Codigo_IBGE AS cidadeIbge, COALESCE(r.D084_Id, 0) AS regiaoId, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.D084_Regiao, ''), 'Sem região cadastrada') AS regiao
INNER JOIN D018 u ON u.D018_Id = ci.D020_D018_Id
LEFT JOIN D084 r ON r.D084_Id = ci.D020_D084_Id
WHERE c.D024_D018_Id = ci.D020_D018_Id AND (c.D024_C004_Id = :empresa OR COALESCE(c.D024_C004_Id, 0) = 0)
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))
